{{Quote|Our sensors are being jammed, along with our communications, both short and long range. Disruptions like this can mean only one thing.|[[Gnost-Dural]]|<ref name="TOR:MaD">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=faction|Republic|Mounting a Defense|Ossus}}</ref>}}
The '''Invasion of Ossus''' was an operation carried out around [[3628 BBY]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] under the direction of [[Darth Malora]], and later [[Darth Malgus]]. Their objective was to destroy a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Colony|farming colony]] established by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] after the [[Eternal Empire]]'s [[Eternal Empire conquest|conquest]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|The Empire thought they could make this a grand first strike in their renewed war against us. They hoped to destroy the Jedi-to destroy us with fear before we ever faced them in open battle.|[[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun]]|<ref name="TOR:TFC">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|type=faction|Republic|The Final Conflagration|Ossus}}</ref>}}
In [[3636 BBY]], the [[Eternal Empire]] under led by the former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] [[Eternal Empire conquest|attacked]] both the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. This onslaught forced many surviving members of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] into [[Exile (punishment)/Legends|hiding]]. By [[3630 BBY]],<ref name="Date KOTFE">{{TOR_updates|4.0}}</ref> Jedi and Sith led by the [[Eternal Alliance]]'s [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] initiated a [[War against Zakuul|revolt]] against the Eternal Empire that would culminate with the death of the former Sith Emperor.<ref name="KOTET 9">{{TORcite|exp=kotet|chapter=9}}</ref>

[[File:Nadia_Grell_inside_the_Colony.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Jedi Knight Nadia Grell monitors the evacuation status.]]
During the conflict, Master [[Gnost-Dural]]'s vision for Ossus was to help the colonists grow crops in order to better support them while [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Tau Idair]] wanted to send out teams to find surviving Jedi. However, Gnost-Dural did not take such action as to ensure that the Jedi remained hidden from the Sith. Sometime after the end of the war against [[Zakuul]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] learned that [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] was alive hiding on the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Colony|farming colony]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. The Empire sent an attack force to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] under the command of [[Dark Council]] member [[Darth Malora]], while [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] General [[Ardinondu Dipolus Daeruun|Daeruun]] sought to reinforce the colony before the Sith could destroy it. With the Eternal Alliance's waning power in the galaxy, they feared a conflict with both main factions, and decided to side with the Jedi and Republic, and the Alliance Commander arrived to assist in the defense of Ossus.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

==Aftermath==
[[File:Republic_Reinforcements.png|thumb|right|250px|Republic reinforcements arrive]]
After Ossus both the Republic and the Sith Empire learned that [[Darth Malgus]] had survived his [[Battle of Ilum|supposed death]] above [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. Darth Malora's seat on the Dark Council was vacated after Malgus overtook her operation on the planet. Additional Republic and Imperial forces arrived at the planet including multiple [[Valor-class cruiser|''Valor''-class cruisers]], [[Thranta-class corvette|''Thranta''-class corvettes]], and [[Harrower-class dreadnought|''Harrower''-class dreadnaughts]], along with their escort fighters.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

==Behind the scenes==
The choices that were made by the player in the Iokath expansion determine whether it is [[Darth Acina]] or [[Darth Vowrawn]] who appear as Empress/Emperor in the Sith storyline. The player's class also determines which companions the player reunites with during the Ossus storyline: the [[Sith Warrior]] class with [[Jaesa Willsaam]], the Jedi Knight class with Doc, the [[Jedi Consular]] class with Nadia Grell, and the [[Sith Inquisitor]] class with [[Khem Val]].<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" /> Imperial classes also encounter [[Valion Pyron|Moff Pyron]], a non-companion from the Inquisitor storyline.

At the end of the storyline, the fate of Gnost-Dural differs between factions. If the player sides with the Empire, they can take Gnost-Dural as a prisoner for [[Light side of the Force/Legends|Light Side]] points or let Malgus kill him for [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark Side]] points. If the player sides with the Republic, Malgus will seriously wound Gnost-Dural and leave him in the library. Idair and the player will find a barely alive Dural and take him to Doc, so he can save him.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />

Additionally, the storyline deals with the farming data that could provide food for either faction amidst the galactic resource crisis. A loyalist player retrieve the data for their faction while a saboteur player fakes the data's destruction and hands it over to the opposing faction.<ref name="Jedi Under Siege" />
